scripts.build: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../frontend/dist && cp static/index.html ../frontend/dist/index.html && cp static/style.css ../frontend/dist/style.css
scripts.build:release: wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir ../frontend/dist && cp static/index.html ../frontend/dist/index.html && cp static/style.css ../frontend/dist/style.css
scripts.watch: cargo watch -s 'wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../frontend/dist && cp static/index.html ../frontend/dist/index.html && cp static/style.css ../frontend/dist/style.css'
